info.name: AarogyaHub API
info.description:
Auth, patients, doctors, appointments, consultations, reports and admin API for AarogyaHub.

1. Start the backend from the backend folder: `.venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000`
2. Create your admin once: `.venv/Scripts/python -m scripts.create_admin`
3. In the 'AarogyaHub local' environment, set adminEmail and adminPassword.
4. Run the collection in order from the repo root folder, so the sample files in postman/files are found. Each run creates a new patient, two new doctors, a booking and a report.
